description: This file implements network connectivity monitoring and endpoint management for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment, including curl-based internet checks, captive portal detection, and endpoint cache handling.

classes.name: EndpointManager
classes.description: Manages network endpoints, including reading from and writing to cache files, and setting endpoints for connectivity monitoring.

classes.name: TestConnectivity
classes.description: Performs curl-based connectivity tests to determine internet status and captive portal presence.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Monitors network connectivity status, manages connectivity checks, and notifies changes.

methods.name: getInternetStateString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the internet status enum.

methods.name: writeEndpointsToFile
methods.description: Writes a list of endpoints to a cache file.

methods.name: readEndpointsFromFile
methods.description: Reads endpoints from a cache file.

methods.name: setConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Sets and caches the list of endpoints for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of monitored endpoints.

methods.name: getDeviceModel
methods.description: Reads device model and build version from /etc/device.properties.

methods.name: TestConnectivity
methods.description: Constructor that initializes connectivity testing with given endpoints and parameters.

methods.name: checkCurlResponse
methods.description: Performs curl multi requests to check internet connectivity and captive portal status.

methods.name: checkInternetStateFromResponseCode
methods.description: Determines internet state based on most frequent HTTP response codes.

methods.name: connectivityMonitorFunction
methods.description: Main loop for periodic connectivity checking and state notification.
